title: Agent File Frontmatter Schema
description: Frontmatter schema for .agent.md files per VS Code custom agent specification

agents.description: Not supported by the Copilot agent harness. Name the subagents to use in the agent body; the subagent tool selects agents by name.

description.description: A brief description of the custom agent, shown as placeholder text in the chat input field

name.description: The name of the custom agent. If not specified, the file name is used

argument-hint.description: Not supported on agents in the Copilot agent harness. Describe expected inputs in the agent body.

tools.description: A list of tool or tool set names available for this custom agent. Can include built-in tools, tool sets, MCP tools, or tools contributed by extensions

skills.description: Skill names to preload into the agent's context when it starts. Each name must match a skill folder name.

model.description: The AI model to use when running the agent. Must be a single scalar string; array/fallback-list values are a VS Code Copilot Chat-only extension not supported by the Copilot CLI. If not specified, the currently selected model in model picker is used.

reasoning-effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent's model. Omit it to let a per-call value from the dispatcher, the session, or the model default apply. The Copilot harness and Copilot CLI apply it; VS Code's Local harness ignores it.

target.description: The target environment or context for the custom agent

mcp-servers.description: Optional list of Model Context Protocol (MCP) server config json to use with custom agents in GitHub Copilot

user-invocable.description: Controls whether the agent appears in the UI for manual invocation.

disable-model-invocation.description: When true, prevents other agents from invoking this agent as a subagent. It does not prevent this agent from invoking agents allowed by its agents and tools fields.

handoffs.description: Not supported by the Copilot agent harness. Describe the next step or agent to switch to in the agent body.
